strings.zh: 今天乔伊带回了华蓝洞穴的战报,{NEWLINE}拥有超梦的坂木老大{CLEAR}依然输给了联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}。{CLEAR}之后老大为了能够打败{VAR:0103:0},{CLEAR}独自一人外出修行了。「三位」{SCROLL}要继续读吗？
strings.en: Today Joy brought back the battle{NEWLINE}report from Cerulean Cave. Boss{CLEAR}Giovanni, even with Mewtwo, lost{CLEAR}again to League Champion {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Afterward, the Boss set{NEWLINE}off alone to train so he can{CLEAR}beat {VAR:0103:0}. ‘Three digits’{SCROLL}Keep reading?
strings.notes: Password puzzle: paper 325003225300469, diary hints 「三位」「编号」「立身之处」 (#92/#93/#95) → ‘Three digits’ / ‘Index number’ / ‘What it stands on’. Script #881 accepts 1-4-2-4-6: split the paper into three-digit Pokédex numbers (Spoink, Venusaur, Delibird, Skitty, Yanmega) and count what each stands on (legs). #90's 07322 is only what Green/Red read out (D-1114, D-1327).

strings.zh: 我仔细研究了超梦的战斗资料,{NEWLINE}发现它的实力绝不在{CLEAR}那个混账冠军的精灵之下,{CLEAR}如果能收集到足够多的{CLEAR}像超梦这样的传说中精灵,{CLEAR}那就一定能够实现,{CLEAR}我们统治世界的目标。「编号」{SCROLL}要继续读吗？
strings.en: I studied Mewtwo’s battle data{NEWLINE}closely. Its power is no less than{CLEAR}that damned Champion’s Pokémon.{SCROLL}If we can gather enough{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon like Mewtwo,{CLEAR}we’ll surely achieve our goal of{CLEAR}ruling the world. ‘Index number’{SCROLL}Keep reading?

strings.zh: 秀力那个老王八蛋{NEWLINE}居然拒绝与我们合作,{CLEAR}看来只能来硬的了。{CLEAR}我就不信在我们的酷刑之下他能挺住。{SCROLL}要继续读吗？
strings.en: That old bastard Hale actually{NEWLINE}refused to work with us. Looks{CLEAR}like we’ll have to get rough.{SCROLL}I’d like to see him hold{NEWLINE}out under our torture.{SCROLL}Keep reading?

strings.zh: 小银大人不辞而别,{NEWLINE}万一他把基地的事说出去……{CLEAR}还是提前做好准备吧。{CLEAR}——阿波罗「立身之处」。
strings.en: Master Silver left without a word. What{NEWLINE}if he tells someone about the base...{SCROLL}Better get ready ahead of{NEWLINE}time. -Archer ‘What it stands on’
strings.notes: 「立身之处」: idiom ‘a foothold’, literally ‘the place the body stands on’ = the Pokémon’s legs (D-1327). ‘Where it stands’ read as a location; ‘What it stands on’ keeps the literal clue.
